sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.description: Sign in with your work email and password.
sign_in.invalid_email: Enter an email address like name@company.com.

second_factor.title: Verify it’s you
second_factor.description: We sent a 6-digit code to your phone on WhatsApp. It works for 5 minutes.
second_factor.exhausted: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again to get a new code.
second_factor.expired: This sign-in step has expired. Sign in again.

enrol.title: Add your phone
enrol.description: Your account asks for a second sign-in step. Enter your mobile number and we will send you codes on WhatsApp.
enrol.phone_hint: A Saudi mobile number that starts with 5.
enrol.phone_invalid: Enter a Saudi mobile number: 5 followed by 8 digits.
enrol.code_description: We sent a 6-digit code to {phone} on WhatsApp.
enrol.done_description: Sign in again with your password; we will send the code to this phone.
enrol.already_enrolled: A phone is already set up for your account. If you changed phones, ask your account owner to reset it: you will get an email with a link to add the new one.

select_account.title: Choose an account
select_account.description: Your email belongs to more than one account. Choose the one to open.

invitation.title: Accept your invitation
invitation.description: Enter your name and choose a password to join your team.
invitation.name: Your name

password.breached: This password appears in a list of leaked passwords. Choose another one.

password_reset.request_description: Enter your work email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
password_reset.sent_description: If an account uses this email, a link to reset the password is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.
password_reset.confirm_description: Choose a password of at least 12 characters. You will be signed out on every device.
password_reset.done_description: Sign in with your new password.

enrol_link.title: Set up your phone again
enrol_link.description: Your second sign-in step was reset. Confirm your password, then add your phone.

link.expired_description: Links work for a limited time. Ask for a new one, or sign in.
link.invalid_description: It may have been used already. Ask for a new one, or sign in.

signed_out.title: You signed out
signed_out.description: You have signed out on this browser.

resend.wait: Resend in {count, plural, one {{value} second} other {{value} seconds}}

totp.title: Enter your authenticator code
totp.description: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for Eeasy Logistics.
totp.enrol_description: The console asks for a code from an authenticator app every time you sign in.
totp.step_install: Install an authenticator app on your phone.
totp.step_scan: Scan this QR code with the app.
totp.step_code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.manual: Or enter this key in the app:
totp.qr_label: QR code to add Eeasy Logistics to your authenticator app
totp.idle_notice: Console sessions end after 12 hours without activity.
totp.exhausted: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
totp.invitation_description: Enter your name and choose a password to join the platform team, then set up your authenticator app.

session.dialog_description: Sign in again to keep working on this page. Your changes stay as they are.
session.dialog_code_description: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your phone on WhatsApp.
session.ended_notice: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
session.suspended_description: Your organisation's account is suspended, so it cannot be used for now. Contact the account owner or our support team.
session.full_sign_in: Continue from the sign-in page: this step cannot be done here.

errors.network: We could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rate_limited_seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {{value} second} other {{value} seconds}}.
errors.rate_limited_minutes: Too many attempts. Try again in {count, plural, one {{value} minute} other {{value} minutes}}.
